stories.headline: Texans Lose Jayden Higgins for the Whole Ride, and Houston's Throws Just Got Redistributed
stories.read: Bad news out of Houston, pardner. Jayden Higgins went down with a torn knee ligament in a joint practice with the Raiders and he's done for 2026 before a single snap that counts. That's a fella who saw 68 looks as a rookie, and every one of those throws is now free land for whoever stakes it first. Nico Collins was already the boss of that outfit and just got fatter, and the next man up in that receiver room is the cheapest gold on the board. Go pan that creek today, because by Sunday the saloon will know.

stories.headline: Pearsall's Knee Finally Gave Out, and the Bay Area Pass Game Needs a New Deputy
stories.read: Hold up there. Ricky Pearsall went under the knife on that stubborn PCL and he's shelved for all of 2026, roughly nine months of mending ahead of him. San Francisco spent camp hopin' that swelling would quit and it never did, so scratch him off your board entirely. The upside for you: Jauan Jennings now carries a mighty big cut of the throws, and George Kittle, who's runnin' ahead of schedule on that busted Achilles, walks back into a target buffet. Kittle at his beat-up price is the diamond in the rough this week.

stories.headline: Najee Harris Rides into New York, and Somebody's Money-Patch Carries Just Went Missing
stories.read: The Giants signed Najee Harris to a one-year deal and cut JuJu Smith-Schuster to make room, which tells you how bad they wanted a battering ram in that backfield. Harris is comin' off a busted Achilles, so don't go reachin' for him like it's 2021, but a 240-pound fella in a run-first outfit tends to find the money patch near the goal line. That's a real dent in the value of whoever New York was pencilin' in for short-yardage work. Cheap late-round flier on Harris, and knock the Giants' other backs down a peg 'til we see the pecking order at that ranch.
